facts.fact: NITA's draft NITA Data Harmonisation Bill 2025 (a bill, not yet law) would give a legal basis for data sharing, standardisation and system integration across public and private institutions; public consultation was set for 19 to 27 November 2025, then Cabinet and Parliament.

note: Bill is a draft; the NITA Director-General says it would make integration mandatory, but nothing in force requires sharing, so no duty fact.
